push_1.title: Farko Push-Up
push_1.description: Samun push-up mai tsabta na farko: jikin kai tsaye, kirji na taɓa ƙasa, cikakken faɗaɗa hannu.

push_2.title: Ƙarfi na Push-Up
push_2.description: Kara ƙarfin push-up ɗinka sau biyu kuma ƙara ingancin tsarin - saitin aiki masu haɗin kai suna buɗe hanyar sama da planche.

push_3.title: Diamond Push-Up
push_3.description: Hannaye suna ƙirƙirar luƙewa a ƙarƙashin kirji, ƙafafu suna bin bayan - yana ƙara ƙarfin triceps da cikin kirji don ƙarfi mafi girma wajen matsawa.

push_4.title: Archer Push-Up
push_4.description: Hannun guda zai lanƙwasa yayin da ɗayan yake faɗaɗa — horo mai rashin daidaito wanda ke gina ƙarfi na ɓangare ɗaya na matsawa zuwa aiki da hannu ɗaya.

push_5.title: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
push_5.description: Hannaye sun juyawa wajen thenka, jikin yakai ƙasa - yana kwaikwayon ɗora planche akan sawu da kafaɗa yayin matsawa.

push_oh_1.title: Pike Push-Up
push_oh_1.description: Fata mata da ƙafafu a rubuce, hannaye a faɗin kafaɗa — rage kai tsakanin hannaye kuma dawo da matsawa daga baya. Yana juyar da nauyi zuwa kafaɗa, yana ƙara makoma zuwa matsa ƙafa zuwa sama.

push_oh_2.title: Elevated Pike Push-Up
push_oh_2.description: ƙafafu a kan akwati ko kujera — kusurwar ya ƙara yawan motsin kafaɗa da nauyi, mataki kai tsaye zuwa handstand push-up.

push_oh_3.title: Wall Handstand Push-Up
push_oh_3.description: salo ƙungiya da bango kuma matsa nauyin jikin kai tsaye sama — mafi shi ne mabuɗin ƙarfi na handstand push-up.

push_oh_4.title: Handstand
push_oh_4.description: daidaita a hannuwanku daga bango — juyawa mai sarrafawa da ke buƙatar ƙarfi na kafada, sassauƙan gyare-gyare na wuya da fahimtar sarari.

push_oh_5.title: Handstand Push-Up
push_oh_5.description: matsawa daga kasa zuwa cikakken kulle yayin da juyawa — mafi girman mataki na ƙarfi na calisthenics na matsa ƙafa sama.

push_pp_1.title: Leaning Planche
push_pp_1.description: fito gaba akan sawu a cikin matsaƙi tare da hannaye juyawa wajen — yana horar da sawu da gaba na kafaɗa domin ɗorawa planche.

push_pp_2.title: Tuck Planche
push_pp_2.description: haɗa ƙafafu biyu daga ƙasa yayin da juyawa akan sawu tare da gurnani cikin turtushi — matsayin planche na gaskiya na farko.

push_pp_3.title: Straddle Planche
push_pp_3.description: ɗaga ƙafafunku a faɗin wuri cikin ɗan siffar straddle yayin riƙe matsayi na planche — ƙalubale sosai fiye da tuck, yana buƙatar cikakkun ƙarfafa jiki.

push_pp_4.title: Full Planche
push_pp_4.description: jiki cikakke a kwance gaba ɗaya, ƙafafu haɗe da kulle — shahararren firgitar matsa stein na calisthenics.

pull_1.title: Farko Pull-Up
pull_1.description: samun cikakken pull-up na farko daga hau ƙyalli mai mutunci.

pull_2.title: Daidaiton Pull-Up
pull_2.description: haɓaka ƙarfin pull-up mai dogon lokaci a cikin saitin da dama. Yana buɗe hanyar Front Lever.

pull_3.title: Negative Pull-Ups
pull_3.description: fara daga ƙasan jikin kai a bar sai ka sauka da hankali sosai. Wannan nau’in eccentric yana gina ƙarfin jan da ake buƙata don Muscle-Up.

pull_fl_1.title: Tuck Front Lever
pull_fl_1.description: daka daga bar, ɗaure gwiwowi zuwa cikin kirji ka riƙe jikin a layi. Yana ginawa ƙarfin scapula da lat don cikakken lever.

pull_fl_2.title: Straddle Front Lever
pull_fl_2.description: faɗaɗa ƙafafunka cikin faɗin straddle ka riƙe cikin layi. Yana tambaya sosai fiye da tuck — yana buƙatar cikakken ƙarfin jiki.

pull_fl_3.title: Full Front Lever
pull_fl_3.description: jiki a ƙasa daidai, hannayen kai tsaye, ƙafafu haɗe da kulle — ɗaya daga cikin mafi ƙaunataccen tsayawar static na calisthenics.

pull_mu_1.title: Pull-Up Daga Kirji Zuwa Bar
pull_mu_1.description: yankewar gaske daga ƙasan jikin kai zuwa bar — tuki har sai kirjinka ya taɓa bar ɗin. Yana buƙatar ƙarfin jan fiye da na al'ada.

pull_mu_2.title: Kipping Muscle-Up
pull_mu_2.description: yi amfani da hop na kafada da kula da lokaci don haifar da kuzari ta hanyar canjin bar. Koyi tsayi kafin cire hop din.

pull_mu_3.title: Strict Muscle-Up
pull_mu_3.description: ba tare da wuyar motsi ko hop ba — jawo tare da tsayayyen ƙarfi daga sama zuwa ƙasa da ƙarfi na jiki mai tsarki. Ginshikin ƙarfin jawo.

pull_am_1.title: Archer Pull-Up
pull_am_1.description: ɗaure hannu ɗaya yayin da ɗayan yake faɗaɗa — horo mai hatsari wanda ke gina ƙarfin lat ɗaya na jiki zuwa pull-up ɗaya na hannu ɗaya.

pull_am_2.title: Typewriter Pull-Up
pull_am_2.description: daga bar sai ka kwashe daga hannu zuwa hannu a saman — abin koyi mai ban mamaki na ƙarfin jan taimako tsaye da iko.

pull_oah_1.title: Hang ɗin Hannu Guda Daya na Aiki
pull_oah_1.description: hang daga bar da hannu guda daya, kafaɗa na cikin aiki da saukewa. Yana ginawa ɗaya daga cikin ƙarfi na kafaɗa na ɓangare ɗaya, juriya ta riƙe, da ƙarfafa ƙashin haɗin gefe.

pull_oapu_1.title: Pull-Up Hannu Guda Daya
pull_oapu_1.description: gwajin ƙarshe na ƙarfin jawo na ɓangare guda — cikakken pull-up na hannu ɗaya ba tare da taimako ba, ba tare da kuzari ba. Daya daga cikin abubuwan da suka fi wuya a calisthenics baki ɗaya.

pull_rings_1.title: Tsaya Tsayayyen Gyaran Rings
pull_rings_1.description: riƙe tallafi mai aiki a kan rings — hannaye kai tsaye, jiki tsaye. Wannan matsayi na asali yana buƙatar ƙarfi na hannu, kira da kafaɗa kafin yin aikin ja na rings.

pull_rings_2.title: Pull-Up Rings
pull_rings_2.description: Cikakken pull-ups a kan rings na gymnastic na ƙarfi na riƙe da iko na kafaɗa wadanda ba a iya yi da bar ɗin ta kulle. Rashin kwanciyar hankali yana sa kowanne rep ya fi wahala.

pull_rings_3.title: Muscle-Up Ring
pull_rings_3.description: Mafi girman ƙarfi na ja da rings: kai tsaye muscle-up a kan rings na gymnastic yana buƙatar ƙwarewar canjin kai, ƙarfi na kafaɗa, da iko na wuyar hannu a ƙarƙashin rashin kwanciyar hankali.

pull_weighted_1.title: Weighted Pull-Up
pull_weighted_1.description: ƙara jakar nauyi ko bel kuma yi pull-ups masu tsauri a ƙarƙashin nauyi. Farawa da 10–20% na nauyinka, ƙarin ƙarfin yana hanzarta samun nasara fiye da horar da jiki kawai.

pull_weighted_2.title: Ƙarfin Volume na Pull-Up na Nauyi
pull_weighted_2.description: Kyakkyawan yin boxen pull-up masu nauyi da manyan repetitions. Yawan ayyukan ƙarƙashin nauyi na ƙarfafa ƙarfin juya jiki da ake buƙata don muscle-up mai nauyi da kuma ɗaukar nauyi mai yawan nauyi.

pull_weighted_3.title: Muscle-Up Mai Nauyi
pull_weighted_3.description: Muscle-up tare da ƙarin nauyi — ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan ƙarfi mafi girma a calisthenics. Yana buƙatar tasiri mai ƙamshi, daidaitaccen lokacin canzawa, da cikakken ƙarfi na jiki gabaɗaya.

core_1.title: Tubalin Plank
core_1.description: Riƙe plank mai kyau — jiki madaidaici daga kai zuwa ƙarshen ƙafafu, kodin da ciki na tsare. Tsarin farawa na kowa da kowa don duk aikin core.

core_2.title: Side Plank
core_2.description: Taimakawa a kan ɗayan gwiwar hannu kuma ɗaga hips ɗinka — yana ƙirƙirar ƙirar core na gefe wanda ke canza kai tsaye zuwa aikin taswirar mutum da kuma ɗagawa da ƙafa suna rataye.

core_hh_1.title: Dead Bug
core_hh_1.description: Ka yalli a baya tare da hannunka da ƙafafunka a cikin sama — rage hannunka da ƙafarka a daidai lokacin tsarkakewa. Mu Assasa bangaren anti-extension na core.

core_hh_2.title: Fadada Bayyanar Bayyanar
core_hh_2.description: A yalli da fuska ƙasa da ɗaga kirjin ka da ƙafafunka daga ƙasa (Superman). Yana ƙara ƙarfin sashen bayanta wanda ke daidaita aikin jikin hollow.

core_hh_3.title: Riƙe Jikin Hollow
core_hh_3.description: Yalli a baya kuma ka tashi cikin wani lanƙwasa na hollow — kafada daga ƙasa, ƙafafu tsare kaɗan. Mafita na asali na ƙarfin cikakken jiki da ke goyon bayan kowanne motsi na calisthenics.

core_hh_4.title: Dragon Flag Negative
core_hh_4.description: Yalli a kan wani tabarma, riƙe bayan kai, sannan a hankali rage jikin daga tsaye zuwa kwance. Matakin na eccentric loading wanda ke shirya ka don cikakken dragon flag.

core_hh_5.title: Dragon Flag
core_hh_5.description: Hujja a bayan kai kuma ka riƙe ko rage jikin ka cikin murshe — kawai kafadunka ne ke taɓa tabarmu. Ƙarfin anti-extension na gaba shine mafi girma.

core_bb_1.title: Hookɗen Rigakafi
core_bb_1.description: Yar da kan rigakafi tare da ƙafafu da aka kwantar suna da kyau — tsarin asali na duk aikin core da jawo jiki da aka yi a kan sanduna.

core_bb_2.title: Hanging Knee Tucks
core_bb_2.description: Yar daga kan sandar kaɗa da gwiwoyinka ga kirji. Yana ƙirƙirar matsa jikin hip-flexor da daidaiton kafada da ke buƙatar don samun aikin core mai wuya.

core_bb_3.title: Hanging Leg Raises
core_bb_3.description: Yar daga sandar da ka ɗaga ƙafafunka madaidaici zuwa kwance — yana buƙatar ƙarfi mai girma a hip-flexor, jurewar kama, da cikakken iko na kashin baya.

core_bb_4.title: Toes to Bar
core_bb_4.description: Daga gurɓa, lanƙwasa jikin gaba ɗaya ka taɓa sandar da ƙafafunka — cikakken ƙarfin hip-flexor, da tuƙi na kama, da iko na jiki duka a motsi guda ɗaya.

core_hf_1.title: Hanging Windshield Wipers
core_hf_1.description: Yar a kan sandar, ɗaga ƙafafunka zuwa matsayi na kwance, sannan ka sare su gefe zuwa gefe. Yana ƙarfafa ƙarfin gefe na core da motsi na hips da ke da muhimmanci don taswirar mutum da wuya da ƙafa.

core_hf_2.title: Human Flag Tucked
core_hf_2.description: Hui da sanda mai tsaye kuma ka riƙe jikin ka madaidaici tare da gwiwoyinka cikin ciki — matsayi na gaskiya na taswirar mutum wanda ke buƙatar ƙananan ƙarfin gefe mai ƙarfi.

core_hf_3.title: Human Flag Guda-ƙafa
core_hf_3.description: Guda ɗaya na kafa na tsawo, guda ɗaya na lanƙwasa — matsayi na wucewa wanda ke rage daidai na leverage sosai yayin da kake koyon ɗaurin gefe don cikakken taswirar mutum.

core_hf_4.title: Human Flag
core_hf_4.description: Hui da sanda mai tsaye kuma ka riƙe dukan jikin ka madaidaici — ayyukan daukan tarihi da ke buƙatar ƙwarewar gefe da ƙarfi na kafada mai ƙarfi.

core_weighted_1.title: Weighted Plank
core_weighted_1.description: Riƙe plank mai ƙarfi tare da faranti masu nauyi ko kayan yadi a baya. Nauyin ƙari na ƙara buƙatar anti-extension, yana mai da wannan hanya mafi inganci don samun ƙarfi na core mai ƙarfi a ƙarƙashin nauyi.

core_weighted_2.title: Weighted Leg Raises
core_weighted_2.description: Yar daga sandar tare da na'urar nauyi a ƙafafunka da kuma ɗaga ƙafafunka zuwa kwance. Yawan nauyin ƙara buƙatar hip-flexor da ƙarfin kama sosai.

core_weighted_3.title: Weighted Dragon Flag
core_weighted_3.description: Yi Dragon Flag tare da ƙari na kayan nauyi — ɗaya daga cikin ayyukan jiki mai nauyi mai saurin rugujewa. Cikakken ƙarfin anti-extension ƙarƙashin nauyi na waje.

core_rings_1.title: Ring Knee Raises
core_rings_1.description: Yar daga kan kayan wasan kwaikwayo na girka kuma ka ɗaga gwiwoyinka zuwa kirji. Rashin kwanciyar hankali yana buƙatar tsawatar mai zurfi na kafada da ƙara ƙarfi na core fiye da sandar ɗin da aka gyara

core_rings_2.title: Ring Rollouts
core_rings_2.description: Daga cikin tsayawa a tsaye, rike kayan girka na wasan kwaikwayo ka yi zamewa zuwa cikakken faɗin fiɗa. Lalacewar rashin kwanciyar hankali na tsufa na buƙatar aiki mai ƙarfi na juriya — fiye da kowanne na wani sandar ko na’ura mai zamewa.

core_roller_1.title: Ab Roller Rollout
core_roller_1.description: Rike ab roller kuma ka zame daga tsayawa a ƙasa zuwa cikakken faɗin, yayin da ka tsare makogwaro. Buƙatar tasiri mai ƙarfi na anti-extension da cikakken motsi ya sa wannan daga cikin ayyukan core masu tasiri sosai masu ɗora nauyi.

core_band_1.title: Banded Pallof Press
core_band_1.description: ajiye bande na juriya a matsayi na kirji ka turawa hannu a cikin kaucewa daga jikin ka yayin da kake yaki da juyawa. Buƙatar anti-rotation na nufin ƙara ƙarfin tsayuwar cinyoyi waɗanda babu wani motsi mai raɗaɗi da zai iya kaiwa.

legs_1.title: Tubalin Kwakwadan dari-dari
legs_1.description: Gina tsarin squat na doble na musamman da zurfi da tsayuwar madaidaici.

legs_2.title: Ikon Squat
legs_2.description: Kara yawan reps na squat da ke daidaita bin dakin gwiwa da zurfi. Yana buɗe hanyar L-Sit da Pistol Squat.

legs_3.title: Shrimp Squat
legs_3.description: Squat guda ɗaya da kafar bayanan na tsaye a bayan ka — yana buƙatar ƙarfi mai girma na quads, motsin mahaifa da daidaito a lokaci guda.

legs_4.title: Bulgarian Split Squat
legs_4.description: Kafafun baya a tsaye, kafa na gaba a gaba — sankowa har sai gwiwar baya ta kai kasa. Daya daga cikin mafi tasiri wajen gina ƙarfin gefe na daban-daban.

legs_ls_1.title: Fadada Pike
legs_ls_1.description: Zauna da kyau da ƙafafunku madaidaici, sannan ka lanƙwasa gaba da su — yana ƙara sassauci na hamstring da ƙarfafa hip-flexor da ake buƙata don cikakken L-sit.

legs_ls_2.title: L-Sit Compressions
legs_ls_2.description: Zauna, ka turawa ƙafafunka ƙasa ka yi ƙoƙarin ɗaga su — yana ƙara ƙarfin adhancin hip-flexor wanda ke maye gurbin sassauci da ƙarfi a cikin L-sit.

legs_ls_3.title: Tuck L-Sit
legs_ls_3.description: Danna akan sanduna masu daidaito ko ƙasa, ka ɗaga hips ka yafe — gwiwoyinka cikin ciki, hannunka a lanƙwasa. Matsayi na kofa zuwa cikakken L-sit.

legs_ls_4.title: Cikakken L-Sit
legs_ls_4.description: Hannaye a rufe, hips a sama, ƙafafu madaidaici da suka forɗo — cikakken nuna ƙarfin hip-flexor, ƙarfin matsa lamba, da ɗawainiya na jiki.

legs_ps_1.title: Mataki-mataki
legs_ps_1.description: Mataki a saman wani jigo mai santsi da iko — yana haɓaka ɗaurewar guda na kafa ɗaya da ƙarfafa quads a matsayin mataki na farko zuwa Pistol Squat.

legs_ps_2.title: Pistol Squat Taimako
legs_ps_2.description: Squat guda ɗaya cikin zurfi da ɗaurewa tare da taimako ko goyon baya — yana gina ƙarfin da sassauci kafin a cire taimako.

legs_ps_3.title: Ƙarƙashin Jikin Squat
legs_ps_3.description: Squat mai haɗin kai da kafa haɗe — yana kusantar yadda Pistol Squat ke aiki da bukatar motsin mahaifa kafin a yi gabaɗaya guda ɗaya.

legs_ps_4.title: Pistol Squat
legs_ps_4.description: Squat guda ɗaya cikin zurfi tare da kafa mai 'yanci da a lanƙwasa — yana buƙatar ƙarfin quads, sassauci na mahaifa da daidaiton jiki gaba ɗaya a cikin motsi mafi inganci.

legs_weighted_1.title: Weighted Goblet Squat
legs_weighted_1.description: Riƙe kettlebell ko dumbbell a matsayi na kirji sannan ka squat zuwa zurfi. Matsayin goblet na inganta ƙirar torso madaidaici da bin migar gwiwa mai zurfi, yana mai da shi hanya mafi kyau don ƙarfi na ƙafafu masu ɗora nauyi.

legs_weighted_2.title: Weighted Bulgarian Split Squat
legs_weighted_2.description: Riƙe dumbbells ka yi split squat na baya mai ɗaurewa ƙafa na baya a sama. Munaɗin load guda ɗaya karkashin wannan matakin stretch na hip-flexor na daga cikin mafi tasiri na gina ƙarfi na ƙafa.

legs_weighted_3.title: Weighted Pistol Squat
legs_weighted_3.description: Yi Pistol Squat cikakke tare da kayan nauyi kamar kettlebell ko faranti — ƙara nauyi a cikin wannan motsi mai buƙata ya buƙatar ƙarfi mai yawa na mahaifa, ƙarfin ɗaya-naƙasa, da daidaiton jiki.

legs_weighted_4.title: Weighted Shrimp Squat
legs_weighted_4.description: Yi shrimp squat da kayan nauyi ko zobe na yadi — ɗaya daga cikin motsin ɗora nauyi na musamman. Yana buƙatar ƙarfi na hips mai ƙarfi, quads, da daidaito a ƙarƙashin juriya na waje.

legs_band_1.title: Hanyar gefe na bandi
legs_band_1.description: Sanya bande na juriya a kan ƙafafu kuma yi tafiya gefe a cikin matsayin squat na kashi ɗaki. Yana mai da hankali kan gluteus medius da abduction na hips da ke daidaita kowane motsi na guda ɗaya na ƙafa.

legs_box_1.title: Jumps na akwatin
legs_box_1.description: Fito daga ƙasa kuma ka sauka shiryen akan akwatin plyo, ka sha bamban da matsawar tashi mai taushi da daidaita. Yana gabatar da saurin haɓakar ƙarfi da adana makamashi elastic.

legs_sliders_1.title: Hamstring Curls na sliders
legs_sliders_1.description: Yar a baya, ka sanya sliders ƙasan ƙafafunka, ka lanƙwasa ƙafafunka zuwa ga jikin, yayin da ka haɗa hips. Buƙatar eccentric mai ƙarfi na haifar da stimulus wanda injuna ba za su iya yin kwatankwacinsa ba.

push_rings_1.title: Ring Dip
push_rings_1.description: Yi dip na kayan girkawa na wasan kwaikwayo tare da kontrol ɗin RTO (Rings Turned Out) a lokacin kulle. Rashin kwanciyar hankali na buƙatar ƙwarewar tricep, kirji, da kafada na ƙwarai a kowane reps.

push_rings_2.title: Ring Muscle-Up
push_rings_2.description: Hada ƙarfin jawo da raunuka a kan kayan zamewa a cikin motsi guda mai ƙarfi sama da kayan. Ƙarfin ring mai ƙarfi na buƙatar daidaiton ƙwarai a duk ƙungiyar matakan motsi.

push_weighted_1.title: Weighted Dip
push_weighted_1.description: Ƙara kaya ko bel kuma yi dip a ƙarƙashin nauyi. Weighted dips suna gina ƙarfi mai ƙarfi na matsa lamba da sauri fiye da kowane motsi na jiki masu haɗin kai na ɗaya.
